turns.replyTail: Je regarde le statut de votre commande et les informations de suivi disponibles. Je reviens vers vous avec les détails utiles.

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
our order leaves our warehouse and is handed to the carrier.

Timing depends on the products and delivery address. Small-parcel deliveries are generally made within 48 to 72 hours. For some carriers, tracking is sent close to delivery: EDELIV provides it about 1 hour before arrival, while Geodis/France Express may send it on the morning of delivery.

To check which timing applies to your order, please send your order number, the email used at checkout, and the phone number used for the purchase.
turns.replyText:
A tracking number is created as soon as your order leaves our warehouse and is handed to the carrier.

To check which timing applies to your order, please send your order number, the email used at checkout, and the phone number used for the purchase.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, we can’t bring the delivery date forward or ask the carrier to speed up its schedule. Your order will be delivered within the time window shown when you placed it. The driver may call shortly before delivery or if you are absent.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Log in to your Tediber account and open “Mes Commandes” (My Orders). Your tracking link will appear there once the order has left our warehouse and been handed to the carrier.

If you do not see it yet, the order may still be being prepared. Some delivery updates only appear as late as one hour before the courier arrives.

turns.q: Can you check the status of my latest order?
turns.replyTail: I can check it, but I need one of these identifiers first: your order number, the email address used at checkout, or the phone number used for the purchase.

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail: Please send me your order number, the email address used at checkout, and the phone number used for the purchase. I need these details to check a delivery marked as delivered but not received.
